title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for sigma_{II}(W) in terms of sigma_I(W).

title: Final Answer for (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the threshold value W_thresh as m + mu.

title: Detailed Balance Application
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the principle of detailed balance to relate the two cross sections.

title: Threshold Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct reasoning and calculations leading to the threshold energy E_gamma.

title: Behavior Above Threshold
description: Optional Criteria: The student should describe how sigma_{II}(W) varies with W just above threshold, including any relevant physical concepts.

title: Momentum Relations
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive and relate the momenta P_alpha and P_beta for both reactions.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as incorrect application of the detailed balance formula or sign mistakes.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
